text_block_list.text:
The front pack rounds the fourth corner!
They're
entering the final straight! Which
of them will
conquer the Kikuka Sho?!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: Haaaaahhhh!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... huff!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: (Hayahide... Her aura's incredible!)
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
The battle between BNW comes to a
head! And
the winner is...
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: Woooooo!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... Ugh, I couldn't win...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: But still!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Out of breath, Уиннинг Тикит looks up
toward
the stands.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Tickezo! You were so close! But what a
great race!
text_block_list.name: Fan A

text_block_list.text:
BNW is the best... I can't keep my eyes
off them!
text_block_list.name: Fan B

text_block_list.text: Woooooo!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Heheh... I was still able to run a great
race!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Heh... Yeah, I let first place slip through
my
fingers...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
But it was still a great race. I feel like I
put up a
good fight!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
My fans were all really excited too, so it
was
worth the effort!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Yeah! After all, winning makes me
happier than
losing!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I gotta say though, Taishin and Hayahide
are
amazing!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
All their power and spirit during the race
made
my skin tingle!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I'm sure that from here on, we'll have
even more
awesome races!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey, is my next race decided
already? I
wanna run with them again!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
If the fan nominations go our way, the
Arima
Kinen will be a strong contender,
but it's too
early to say that for sure.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
For now, a good target might be the
Osaka Hai,
often said to be the race that
decides the
greatest senior
medium-distance runner of the
spring
season.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
There's a fair chance Нарита Таисин and
Biwa
Hayahide will enter as well.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: The Osaka Hai? Sure, I'm in!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
All right, I'll go full speed at the Osaka
Hai and
give my fans a great show!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Уиннинг Тикит is pumped for her next
goal, the
Osaka Hai.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, two figures are quietly
watching her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
